''Triticum ovatum'' }} [[File:Aegilops geniculata MHNT.BOT.2011.18.8.jpg|thumb|''Aegilops geniculata'' - [[MHNT]]]] '''''Aegilops geniculata''''' is a species of [[Poaceae|grass]] known by the common name '''ovate goatgrass'''. It is native to the Mediterranean and western Asia, including [[Palestine (region)|Palestine]] and the [[Levant]]. Elsewhere it is known as a [[noxious weed]].
